content: उपकॢप् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To be fit for; तत्रेदमुपकल्पते <ls>Bhāg.</ls> .²2 To be prepared or ready (at hand); आसनेषूपकॢप्तेषु <ls>Ms. 3. 208</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 333</ls>. .²3 To result in, serve as, lead to (with <ab>dat.</ab>); वार्यपि श्रद्धया दत्तमक्षयायोपकल्पते <ls>Ms. 3. 202</ls>. .²4 To become, take a (particular) form or shape. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To prepare, get ready, equip; रथम् <ls>Ve. 2</ls>. .²2 To appoint, assign, allot; उपकल्पितं पशुम् <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; <ls>U. 2</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 109</ls>. .²3 To vow, promise; देवतोपकल्पित <ls>Pt. 4</ls>. .²4 To set up, exhibit; इति मतिरुपकल्पिता वितृष्णा <ls>Bhāg. 1. 9. 32</ls>. .²5 To render (homage), communicate. .²6 To bring near, fetch. .²7 To assume, take.
